chest_press.end: Arms pressed forward almost straight with slight elbow bend, shoulders protracted, back still against pad, hands holding handles in front of chest.
chest_press.end_img: seated upright pushing both handles forward until arms almost straight, elbows slightly bent, feet flat, weight stack lifted forward
chest_press.setup: Seated on chest-press machine with upright padded backrest; seat height so handles sit at mid-chest; feet flat on floor, hands grasping dual handles, weight stack behind.
chest_press.start: Seated, back against pad, hands on handles beside chest, elbows about 45° from torso, shoulders relaxed, torso upright.
chest_press.start_img: seated upright on machine holding both handles beside chest, elbows angled out, feet flat on floor, weight stack visible behind
steps_it: Regola il sedile: maniglie all'altezza del petto.
Appoggia la schiena, stringi le scapole.
Spingi le maniglie in avanti fino a quasi estensione.
Ritorna controllato senza far toccare i pesi.

croci_cavi.end: Arms brought together in front of lower chest so hands meet, elbows slightly bent forming an arc, torso maintained slightly leaned.
croci_cavi.end_img: standing slightly inclined forward bringing both hands together in front of lower chest, arms slightly bent, cables converging toward hands
croci_cavi.setup: Standing centered between two high pulleys, one single handle in each hand, staggered stance with one foot forward, slight forward lean from the hips.
croci_cavi.start: Standing with arms out wide to the sides, elbows soft (slight bend), hands holding handles, cables taut, torso slightly inclined forward.
croci_cavi.start_img: standing between two high pulleys holding a handle in each hand, arms wide to the sides, palms facing each other, one foot forward, cables taut
steps_it: Posizionati tra le carrucole con un passo avanti.
Mantieni busto leggermente inclinato e core compatto.
Chiudi le braccia ad arco fino a incontrare le mani.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione iniziale.

stacco_bil.end: Standing tall with hips and knees fully extended, torso upright, shoulders back, barbell held close to thighs at hip level.
stacco_bil.end_img: standing tall holding barbell at hip level close to thighs, hips and knees fully extended, shoulders back, bar in both hands
errors_it: Tirare con le braccia invece delle gambe
stacco_bil.muscles: latissimus dorsi, rhomboids and lower back
stacco_bil.setup: Olympic barbell with black bumper plates on floor over mid-foot; feet hip-width, toes slightly out, hands gripping bar outside knees with double overhand or mixed grip.
stacco_bil.start: Hips low, knees bent, back neutral, chest up, shoulders slightly in front of the bar, hands gripping the bar just outside knees, bar resting on floor.
stacco_bil.start_img: standing with hips low gripping barbell with both hands overhand, hands outside knees, back neutral, bar resting on floor over mid-foot
steps_it: Piedi alla larghezza delle anche, bilanciere sopra il centro del piede.
Afferra il bilanciere con schiena neutra e petto alto.
Spingi il pavimento estendendo anche e ginocchia, porta il bilanciere lungo le gambe.
In alto estendi completamente anche e ginocchia, poi scendi controllato.

lat_machine.end: Bar pulled down to upper chest, elbows down and back, torso slightly leaned back, bar close to chest.
lat_machine.end_img: seated pulling the bar down to upper chest with elbows down and back, bar close to chest, thighs locked under pads
lat_machine.muscles: latissimus dorsi, rhomboids and lower back
lat_machine.setup: Seated at lat pulldown station with thighs locked under pads, long bar attached to high cable; hands wide grip slightly wider than shoulders, feet flat on floor.
lat_machine.start: Seated upright with arms fully extended overhead holding wide bar, chest up, shoulders relaxed, knees secured under pads.
lat_machine.start_img: seated upright holding wide bar overhead with both hands, arms fully extended, thighs locked under pads, feet flat, bar hanging from high cable
steps_it: Blocca le cosce sotto i rulli e afferra la barra larga.
Petto alto, contrai i dorsali prima di tirare.
Tira la barra verso la parte alta del petto con gomiti giù e indietro.
Risalire lentamente fino alle braccia tese.

alzate_laterali.end: Both arms raised laterally to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent, palms facing down, torso stable.
alzate_laterali.end_img: standing with both arms raised sideways to shoulder height holding dumbbells, elbows slightly bent, body stable and upright
alzate_laterali.setup: Standing with pair of black hexagonal dumbbells held at sides, feet hip-width, slight elbow flexion, neutral spine, palms facing the body.
alzate_laterali.start: Standing upright holding dumbbells at sides, arms relaxed with slight elbow bend, shoulders down, core braced.
alzate_laterali.start_img: standing upright holding dumbbells at sides, arms slightly bent at elbows, feet hip-width, dumbbells resting by the hips
steps_it: In piedi con manubri ai fianchi e core attivo.
Alza lateralmente mantenendo gomiti leggermente flessi.
Arriva all'altezza delle spalle senza sbilanciarti.
Scendi lentamente sotto controllo.

curl_bil.end: Forearms flexed, barbell at shoulder level close to chest, elbows fixed at sides, shoulders relaxed.
curl_bil.end_img: standing with forearms flexed holding barbell at shoulder level, elbows pinned to sides, bar close to chest
curl_bil.setup: Standing holding straight Olympic barbell with black plates, supinated grip shoulder-width, feet hip-width, elbows tucked to sides.
curl_bil.start: Standing upright holding barbell at mid-thigh with arms fully extended, wrists neutral, elbows close to sides, core braced.
curl_bil.start_img: standing upright holding barbell at mid-thigh with both hands supinated, arms straight, elbows close to sides, feet hip-width
steps_it: Presa supina, piedi stabili alla larghezza delle anche.
Mantieni gomiti fermi ai fianchi durante la salita.
Contrai i bicipiti e porta il bilanciere in alto.
Scendi lentamente fino a braccia completamente tese.

squat_bil.end: Bottom squat with hips pushed back and down, thighs at least parallel to floor, knees tracking toes, spine neutral, barbell over mid-foot.
squat_bil.end_img: deep squat with thighs at least parallel to floor, hips back, knees bent, barbell across upper back close to shoulders
errors_it: Curvare la schiena durante la discesa
squat_bil.setup: Standing under straight Olympic barbell placed on upper trapezius, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly outward, hands gripping bar outside shoulders.
squat_bil.start: Standing tall with barbell on upper back, hips and knees extended, torso upright, core braced, eyes forward.
squat_bil.start_img: standing under barbell across upper back holding it with both hands, feet shoulder-width, knees and hips extended, torso upright
steps_it: Posiziona il bilanciere sui trapezi e piedi larghezza spalle.
Inspira, contrae l'addome e spingi le anche indietro.
Scendi controllato almeno fino alle cosce parallele.
Risali spingendo con tutto il piede fino alla posizione iniziale.

leg_press.end: Legs pushed out nearly straight with knees soft (not locked), feet on platform, hips and back pressed into seat, sled extended upward.
leg_press.end_img: lying back pushing platform so legs are nearly extended, knees soft, feet on platform, sled pushed upward away from body
leg_press.setup: 45-degree leg press: lying back on inclined padded seat, feet shoulder-width placed mid-high on large sloped platform, back and pelvis pressed to pad, hands on side grips.
leg_press.start: Lying with knees bent close to chest, feet shoulder-width on platform, hips and back pressed to pad, sled loaded with weight behind platform.
leg_press.start_img: lying back on a 45-degree leg press seat with feet shoulder-width on platform, knees deeply bent near chest, hands on side grips, sled loaded
steps_it: Appoggia schiena e bacino al sedile, piedi alla larghezza spalle.
Sblocca la pedana e scendi piegando le ginocchia verso il petto.
Spingi con i talloni ed estendi le gambe senza bloccarle.
Ritorna controllato alla posizione di partenza.

leg_curl.end: Hips remain on pad, knees maximally flexed bringing heels toward glutes; ankles neutral; torso stable on bench; elbows same; roller pad lifted toward buttocks, weight stack raised.
leg_curl.end_img: lying face down, hands still on side handles, lower legs curled so heels pressed toward the glutes under the roller pad, knees bent and weight stack lifted
leg_curl.setup: Lying face down on a selectorized leg‑curl bench, hips centered on pad, roller pad positioned just above the heels, hands holding side handles, feet hip‑width apart.
leg_curl.start: Torso prone and pressed to bench, hips neutral; legs fully extended, knees straight; ankles neutral; elbows slightly bent holding handles; roller pad resting above heels with weight stack down.
leg_curl.start_img: lying face down on bench, hands gripping side handles, lower legs straight with the roller pad resting just above the heels, feet together, weight stack at rest behind machine
steps_it: Sdraiati prono con rullo sopra i talloni.
Impugna le maniglie e mantieni i fianchi stabili.
Fletti le ginocchia portando i talloni verso i glutei.
Abbassa lentamente controllando la resistenza.

hip_thrust_bil.end: Hips fully extended and elevated so torso and thighs form a straight line, knees still bent, feet planted, shoulders on bench, barbell driven upward on the pelvis, hands holding bar to steady.
hip_thrust_bil.end_img: hips thrust high so torso and thighs form a straight line, feet planted, barbell elevated on the pelvis with hands steadying it, shoulders still on the bench
errors_it: Estendere la schiena invece delle anche.
Piedi posizionati troppo lontani o troppo vicini.
hip_thrust_bil.setup: Upper back high on a flat bench, feet flat shoulder‑width on floor, Olympic barbell with bumper plates padded across the pelvis, hands lightly gripping bar, bench perpendicular to feet.
hip_thrust_bil.start: Upper back braced on bench, shoulders supported; hips lowered near floor, hips partially flexed; knees bent about 90°; feet flat; barbell resting on pelvis with hands steadying it.
hip_thrust_bil.start_img: upper back against bench, body low with hips near floor, feet flat shoulder‑width, barbell padded and resting across the pelvis, hands holding the bar at the sides
steps_it: Posiziona la parte superiore della schiena sulla panca.
Piazza il bilanciere imbottito sul bacino e afferralo.
Spingi le anche verso l'alto fino a estensione completa.
Abbassa controllato mantenendo il core attivo.
